title: Hip hop and how it began
examples: What was the atmosphere like in the Bronx in the 1970s?
Can you explain the difference between DJing and MCing?
How did graffiti art fit into the hip hop culture?

explain.say: The early days of hip hop culture started in a place called The Bronx.

draw.text: Hip hop and how it began

explain.say: One key element was DJing, which involved mixing records together.
MCing meant the Master of Ceremonies, who rapped over the music.
Breaking was a dance form that involved energetic athletic movements.
Graffiti was the art of writing and painting on public surfaces.
In everyday life, think about a modern party or concert setting.

faq.q: Where exactly did hip hop originate?
faq.a: Hip hop culture developed in The Bronx, New York, during the 1970s. It grew from local community events and creativity.
asks: What was the birthplace of hip hop?
When and where did hip hop start?

faq.q: What is the difference between DJing and MCing?
faq.a: DJing is the art of mixing and playing records to create the beat. MCing is the vocal performance, which is rapping over that beat.
asks: Does the DJ sing or rap?
Who is the rapper in a hip hop group?

faq.a: Breaking is a specific style of dance that involves acrobatic and rhythmic movements. It is a core element of the culture.
asks: What kind of dancing is breaking?
Is breaking related to martial arts?

faq.q: How did graffiti fit into the music scene?
faq.a: Graffiti was a visual art form that shared the same cultural roots as the music. It expressed the same energy and community spirit.
asks: Did graffiti artists perform at concerts?

faq.q: Were these elements all invented at the same time?
faq.a: No, they developed together as part of a single cultural movement. They supported each other to create the whole art form.
asks: Did the elements appear one by one?

facts: Hip hop culture emerged in The Bronx during the 1970s.
DJing involves manipulating records to create continuous sound.
MCing is the vocal element, often involving rhythmic speaking called rapping.
Breaking is a highly athletic street dance style.

quiz.say: Which element involved mixing records to create the beat?
quiz.why: DJing is specifically the skill of mixing records together to build the musical foundation.

wrong.0: Breaking is a physical dance style, not a musical technique.
wrong.1: Graffiti is visual art, it does not create sound.
wrong.3: MCing is the vocal part, so it does not involve mixing records.

quiz.say: What was the primary location for the start of this culture?
quiz.why: The Bronx is the historically recognized location where these cultural elements began to develop.

wrong.1: While nearby, the specific cultural explosion is linked to The Bronx.
wrong.2: Brooklyn was part of the scene, but The Bronx is cited as the origin.
wrong.3: Times Square is a commercial area, not the cultural hub for its start.

quiz.say: If a person is rapping over a beat, what are they doing?
quiz.why: MCing refers to the role of the Master of Ceremonies, which is rapping.

wrong.1: DJing is about the music source, not the vocals.
wrong.2: Breaking is a physical dance, not a vocal performance.
wrong.3: Painting is graffiti, which is a visual art form.
